doctrine.rule: Name the shadow. Never steal its payload. Public nodes are resources to crunch. Private nodes are reminders to legally check every public link around them. Unreachable feeds stay as named nodes, not blank space.

classes.CANON: On-lattice receipts: dual ledgers, eggs, Star Chart feed, Agent Agora pulse.
classes.RESOURCE: Public GET we may crunch: USGS, NASA EONET, ISS, GDACS, ReliefWeb, NHC, NWS, UN/WHO wires. news-monitor.json + event-ledger.json are RESOURCE snapshots. If the GET fails, the node stays named with its public URL. Event ledger is not dual-ledger CANON and never silent Star Chart ingest.
classes.SHADOW: Private or unreachable rooms. Existence + why + public_checks. payload always null.
classes.SCHEMATIC: Lattice-sphere placement is a graph projection, not a geographic claim.
